title: Separate tool schema catalog, provider-format serializers, activation policy, and command management
description: AstrBot's FunctionToolManager and command management mix tool catalog, provider-specific schema serialization, MCP activation, command toggles, renames, permissions, and conflict detection. Rust should keep these as separate typed boundaries before tool-call parity.

files.target: tool catalog and schema module tree
files.change: Define tool descriptors, command descriptors, provider schema serializers, activation policy, conflict detection, and permission views.
Keep provider adapters consuming already-shaped tool schemas instead of owning command/catalog policy.

criteria: OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini tool schema serialization is separated from tool execution.
Command management can persist toggles/renames without mutating plugin registry internals directly.
ProviderRequest keeps lightweight tool references rather than full command state.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-plugin && cargo test -p astrbot-provider && cargo test --workspace
